_about: Per-prompt energy and water estimates for cloud models. Local answers are measured, not taken from here. See docs/ENERGY_METHODOLOGY.md. Looked up 23 Nov 2026.

grid.label: CEA v22.0
grid.source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, User Guide Version 22.0 (Aug 2026), Table S: weighted average emission factor FY 2025-26, 0.675 tCO2/MWh

openai/gpt-oss-120b.label: median prompt, Google 2025
openai/gpt-oss-120b.source: Elsworth et al. (Google), Measuring the environmental impact of delivering AI at Google scale, arXiv:2508.15734 (2025): median Gemini Apps text prompt 0.24 Wh, 0.26 mL
openai/gpt-oss-120b.notes: No verified per-prompt figure for gpt-oss-120b as served by Groq (Groq runs on LPUs, not GPUs). Hugging Face measured 1.84-8.31 Wh per query on a whole 8xA100 node with unstated batch size; not representative of a batched production API. Range is x0.5 / x2 as in the methodology.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.label: median prompt, Google 2025
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.source: Elsworth et al. (Google), arXiv:2508.15734 (2025): median Gemini Apps text prompt 0.24 Wh, 0.26 mL
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.notes: Google's figure covers Gemini Apps overall, not this model specifically. Range x0.5 / x2.

openai/gpt-oss-20b.label: est. from Google 2025 x HF 20B/120B ratio
openai/gpt-oss-20b.source: Google median prompt 0.24 Wh (arXiv:2508.15734) x 0.25, the gpt-oss-20b / gpt-oss-120b energy ratio measured by Hugging Face (Luccioni, The GPT-OSS models are here, Aug 2025: 0.49/1.84, 0.98/3.83, 2.02/8.31 Wh at 25/50/100 output tokens)
openai/gpt-oss-20b.notes: Ratio is consistent at 0.24-0.27 across output lengths in that study. Only used when the local model is unavailable. Range x0.5 / x2.

cpu_overhead.label: CPU time x assumed package power
cpu_overhead.source: Embedding, cache lookup and router are timed; energy = seconds x CPU_ASSUMED_W (15 W assumed package power, set in .env)
